question:
**Direction: Complete the sentence with the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets.**

The ________ (**glowing**) fireflies lit up the field like city lights at night.
solution:
The correct answer is **"dazzling."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "glowing"** in the sentence means shining or emitting light. (चमकना या प्रकाश उत्सर्जित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *There were **glowing**__ LEDs.*
 
 
 
• The synonym for** "glowing"** that best fits the context of the sentence is **"dazzling."**
 
• **"Dazzling" **means extremely bright or impressive. (चौंधिया देने वाला)
 __
 
• **Example**: *That was a **dazzling**__ light.*
 
 
 
• The use of the word **"like" **indicates a comparison between the fireflies and city lights at night, emphasizing the brightness and beauty of the scene.
 
• The sentence uses a simile to create a vivid image of the field at night.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (devious)** means deceitful or dishonest. (चालबाज़, छली)
 
• **Option 3 (furious) **means very angry or violent. (बहुत क्रुद्घ)
 
• **Option 4 (gracious) **means kind or courteous. ((व्‍यक्ति या उसका आचरण) दयालु, नम्र और उदार)
